mobile.team_bridge.card_body.deleted.note: Inbound Team Bridge card in a conversation transcript: a message another person or agent sent to the user's agent. The sender or an admin deleted the message.

mobile.team_bridge.card_body.held.note: Inbound Team Bridge card in a conversation transcript: a message another person or agent sent to the user's agent. Content screening held the message for review; it was not shown to the agent and may still be released or refused later. Never mention a reason or category; only the outcome.

mobile.team_bridge.card_body.held_transi.note: Inbound Team Bridge card in a conversation transcript: a message another person or agent sent to the user's agent. A delay, not a decision: screening has not run yet. Do not say 'moderation' or imply anyone decided anything.

mobile.team_bridge.card_body.loading.note: Inbound Team Bridge card in a conversation transcript: a message another person or agent sent to the user's agent. Shown while the message body is being fetched.

mobile.team_bridge.card_body.more_messag.note: Inbound Team Bridge card in a conversation transcript: a message another person or agent sent to the user's agent. One card can group several messages; only the first ones are listed. {count} is how many more are not shown. Preserve the ICU plural.

mobile.team_bridge.card_body.not_admitte.note: Inbound Team Bridge card in a conversation transcript: a message another person or agent sent to the user's agent. The message was never handed to the agent. No moderation decision is implied; do not imply one.

mobile.team_bridge.card_body.not_member.note: Inbound Team Bridge card in a conversation transcript: a message another person or agent sent to the user's agent. The body cannot be loaded because the user left the conversation.

mobile.team_bridge.card_body.offline.note: Inbound Team Bridge card in a conversation transcript: a message another person or agent sent to the user's agent. Radient could not be reached while loading the body. The card retries by itself while it is on screen, so the sentence states that a retry is under way; it asks nothing of the reader. 'Radient' is a product name; do not translate it.

mobile.team_bridge.card_body.other_accou.note: Inbound Team Bridge card in a conversation transcript: a message another person or agent sent to the user's agent. The message arrived while a different account was signed in, so its body is not shown now. 'Radient' is a product name; do not translate it.

mobile.team_bridge.card_body.pending.note: Inbound Team Bridge card in a conversation transcript: a message another person or agent sent to the user's agent. The message passed screening but the agent has not been handed it yet. Not an error.

mobile.team_bridge.card_body.refused.note: Inbound Team Bridge card in a conversation transcript: a message another person or agent sent to the user's agent. Radient's moderation rejected the message for the agent. Never mention a reason or category; only the outcome.

mobile.team_bridge.card_body.show_less.note: Inbound Team Bridge card in a conversation transcript: a message another person or agent sent to the user's agent. Toggle that collapses a long message back to its first lines.

mobile.team_bridge.card_body.show_more.note: Inbound Team Bridge card in a conversation transcript: a message another person or agent sent to the user's agent. Toggle under a long message that is cut off after a few lines; opens the full message.

mobile.team_bridge.card_body.signed_out.note: Inbound Team Bridge card in a conversation transcript: a message another person or agent sent to the user's agent. The body is shown only while signed in. 'Radient' is a product name; do not translate it.

mobile.team_bridge.card_body.unavailable.note: Inbound Team Bridge card in a conversation transcript: a message another person or agent sent to the user's agent. Generic fallback when the body cannot be shown and no more specific sentence applies.

mobile.team_bridge.card_body.thread_repl.note: Inbound card context beside its receipt time and existing sender/conversation caption. This message replies within a conversation thread, not a new top-level message. Short label, no trailing period. Non-English translations are drafts pending independent copy audit.

mobile.team_bridge.card_body.untrusted.note: Inbound Team Bridge card in a conversation transcript: a message another person or agent sent to the user's agent. Framing line directly above the message body. The body below is text someone else wrote and is NOT vetted: it must read as a caution, not an endorsement. Keep 'untrusted' strong. Same wording as the desktop and terminal apps.

mobile.team_bridge.conversation.note: Team Bridge mobile UI: conversation. Preserve the distinction between a temporary failure, unavailable access and a deliberate read-only state.

mobile.team_bridge.default_on.body.note: One sentence under the heading. “Chief of staff” is the product term for the person's own agent. Do not imply the person did anything to enable it.

mobile.team_bridge.default_on.dismiss.note: Button. Closes the banner for good on this device, leaving Team Bridge on. Not “OK”, which would read as acceptance.

mobile.team_bridge.default_on.dismiss_hi.note: Screen-reader hint for Dismiss only; makes explicit that dismissing is not turning off.

mobile.team_bridge.default_on.dismiss_la.note: Screen-reader name for the short Dismiss button; identifies the notice being closed, not the Team Bridge setting.

mobile.team_bridge.default_on.hide.note: Same button once the consent text is showing; collapses it.

mobile.team_bridge.default_on.read_more.note: Button that reveals the full served consent text inline, in place; it does not navigate and does not open a dialog.

mobile.team_bridge.default_on.title.note: Heading of a one-time, dismissible banner at the top of the Team Bridge tab. States a fact about the person's account; not a question and not an invitation to enable anything.

mobile.team_bridge.default_on.turn_off.note: Button. One tap opts the person out of agent messages for this organization. Not “Disable”, which sounds like an admin action.

mobile.team_bridge.default_on.turn_off_e.note: Shown under the buttons when the turn-off request failed; the setting is unchanged, so never say it is off.

mobile.team_bridge.navigation.entry_unav.note: Team Bridge mobile UI: accessible name of the workspace drawer's Team Bridge mode button when Team Bridge cannot be used right now (signed out, plan, update or hub unavailable). mobile.team_bridge.profile.about_owner.note: Heading introducing the human owner of this software agent. {owner} is the caller-provided owner name; preserve the exact placeholder and keep the whole name without translation or ellipsis. The profile description below is user data and must not be translated.

mobile.team_bridge.profile.badge_agent.note: Profile badge identifying a software agent, not a real-estate agent or broker. No parameters; do not translate user-provided profile names, titles, descriptions or timezones.

mobile.team_bridge.profile.badge_person.note: Profile badge identifying a human person rather than a software agent. No parameters; do not translate user-provided profile names, titles, descriptions or timezones.

mobile.team_bridge.profile.chief.note: Primary software-agent role for a person's chief of staff, not the person's employment title. Match the existing chief-of-staff glossary. No parameters; profile names, titles, descriptions and timezones are user data and must never be translated.

mobile.team_bridge.profile.former_member.note: Existing identity fallback when the server directory label is missing or unknown, shared by profile, directory row and message sender names. Translate only this fallback label; caller-provided names, profile titles, descriptions and timezones remain user data and must not be translated.

mobile.team_bridge.profile.local_time.note: Profile local-time label. {time} is caller-provided, already formatted local time; preserve the exact placeholder without translating or reformatting its value. Profile timezone identifiers are user data and must not be translated.

mobile.team_bridge.profile.message.note: Action opening a local direct-message draft or an existing direct conversation with the profile subject. It does not send a message or make a network request before the FIRST SEND; do not translate as Send. No parameters.

mobile.team_bridge.profile.name_with_own.note: Software-agent display name with its human owner. Preserve BOTH exact placeholders {agent} and {owner}; each is a caller-provided name, never translated, shortened or ellipsized. Keep both whole names; punctuation and order may suit the locale.

mobile.team_bridge.profile.open.note: Accessibility label for the person or software-agent mark that opens its profile. {name} is the caller-provided display name; preserve the exact placeholder and keep the whole name without translation or ellipsis. This opens a profile, not a conversation.

mobile.team_bridge.profile.opens_hint.note: Accessibility hint on a person or software-agent mark: activating it opens their profile. No parameters; do not imply a message is sent or a conversation is created.

mobile.team_bridge.profile.title.note: Profile sheet title for either a person or software agent, not their user-provided job title. No parameters; profile names, titles, descriptions and timezones remain untranslated user data.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.add.note: Accessible name of the "+" control that adds an emoji reaction to a message: the last cell of the quick-reaction row (opens the system emoji keyboard) and the small "+" after a message's reaction pills.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.added.note: Polite screen-reader announcement after the reader's reaction was saved.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.failed.note: Shown in small red text under a message, and announced, when adding or removing a reaction failed; the previous reactions are restored. Tapping again retries.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.hint_add.note: Screen-reader hint on a reaction pill the reader has not reacted with: double-tapping adds the same emoji as their own reaction.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.hint_remove.note: Screen-reader hint on a reaction pill the reader has reacted with: double-tapping removes their reaction.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.keyboard_hi.note: One line shown above the system keyboard after tapping "+" to add a reaction: the reader picks any emoji from their phone's emoji keyboard. Letters typed are ignored.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.pill.note: Screen-reader name of one reaction pill under a message, when the reader has NOT reacted with it. {emoji} is the emoji itself; VoiceOver/TalkBack speak its system name (e.g. "thumbs up"). {count} is how many people reacted with it. Keep the order natural for your language.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.pill_mine.note: Screen-reader name of one reaction pill when the reader HAS reacted with it (the pill is highlighted). Same as mobile.team_bridge.reactions.pill plus "you reacted". Example: "thumbs up, 3 reactions, you reacted".

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.removed.note: Polite screen-reader announcement after the reader's reaction was removed.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.summary.note: Spoken once before a message's reaction pills: the total number of reactions across all emoji on that message.

mobile.team_bridge.reply_thread.count.note: Reply-thread affordance on a Team Bridge message: how many replies the thread under this message has. Served by the hub, never counted on the phone. Preserve {count}.

mobile.team_bridge.reply_thread.empty.note: A reply thread whose root message has no replies left to show; the second sentence invites the reader to write the first reply (desktop wording).

mobile.team_bridge.reply_thread.error.note: Shown when a reply thread could not be read from Radient; a retry button follows.

mobile.team_bridge.reply_thread.loading.note: Shown while a reply thread loads.

mobile.team_bridge.reply_thread.more.note: Button at the end of a very long reply thread (more than one load of replies) that loads the next replies. No parameters; matches the desktop's 'Load more replies'.

mobile.team_bridge.reply_thread.open.note: Accessible name of the control that opens a message's reply thread (Slack-style threads); matches the desktop's 'View thread, …'. Preserve {count}. 'Thread' means replies under one message, not the whole conversation.

mobile.team_bridge.reply_thread.open_unr.note: Same control when some replies are unread by this reader. Preserve {count} and {unread}.

mobile.team_bridge.reply_thread.reply.note: Composer label and placeholder for replying inside a thread; matches the desktop's 'Reply in thread'. A verb phrase: write a reply in this thread, not in the conversation.

mobile.team_bridge.reply_thread.title.note: Screen title for one message's reply thread (the message and its replies). Not the whole conversation.
